text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day. There have been no changes in his bowel habits or urination. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (likely Breastfeeding Jaundice or early onset Hyperbilirubinemia). The clinical picture of a 5-day-old full-term infant with progressive jaundice starting on the face and trunk, but normal stool/urine patterns and adequate feeding, is consistent with physiological or subphysiological breastfeeding jaundice rather than biliary atresia or infection.
